1164-2173-3002-4740.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 16 or higher.
1164-2173-3002-4740.description:
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping it and exiling it due to Rest in Peace, choosing Mirror of Fate and up to six other cards from exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, ensuring to place Mirror of Fate on top of your library.
Cast Mirror of Fate from the top of your library by paying 5 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
1164-2173-3002-4740.notes: You can cast the other spells you exile with Mirror of Fate each loop if your life total allows. You can also start with less life if you've cast spells during the turn prior to starting the combo. Another option is to place small mana value spells on top of Mirror of Fate and cast them to increase your storm count so Aetherflux Reservoir will give you more life faster.

2645-3430-4717-5475.description:

Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.

When the tokens enter, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three creature tokens, adding six {C}.

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

225-1308-4365-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.

3532-3594-5078-7913.description:

Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.

2073-4779-7876-7878.description:

When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

413-1580-4871-5075.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Ogre Slumlord and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

3499-4499-6723-7393.description:

When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Semblance Anvil.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Lutri.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.

Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.

2034-4871-5497-6000-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sapphire Medallion.
Repeat.

57-2341-4846-5223.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
57-2341-4846-5223.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2033-3490-4927-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
2033-3490-4927-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1978-2464-3430.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1978-2464-3430.description:

Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the artifact creature.
Repeat.

Pemmin's Aura attached to Kiora's Follower.

116-1846-3525.description:

Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {R}.
The sacrificed creature's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to draw a card.
The -1/-1 and +1/+1 counters are removed as a state-based action.

277-1479-4488-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-4488-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Revolutionist.

Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.

Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

When Tilling Treefolk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning two land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tilling Treefolk, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2050-4222-5387.easyPrerequisites:

Buried in the Garden attached to a Forest you control.

2050-4222-5387.description:

Activate the ability granted to the Forest by the Aura, adding {G}.
The triggered ability from the Aura triggers, adding an additional {U}.
Activate the Aura attached to Arbor Elf by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.

Regal Caracal dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Regal Caracal from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Regal Caracal enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cat, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2724-3504-4006.description:

Pay {2}{U}{U} to return it to your hand, triggering Wormfang Manta's LTB, granting you an extra turn after this one.

1247-2464-3099.notablePrerequisites:
Song of Freyalise has exactly one or two lore counters on it.

Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding two mana of any one color.

1768-2034-5189.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1768-2034-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Juniper Order Ranger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Juniper Order Ranger and the Saproling.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from the Saproling.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ghave ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colorless mana and +1/+1 counters on Juniper Order Ranger, you may activate Ghave's first ability to create infinite Saproling tokens.
You may then also activate Ghave's second ability infinite times to put infinite +1/+1 counters on all creatures you control.
